name: Mathematics Lab
about: The layers of ARCHITECTURE.md, bottom first. The kit core (complex numbers, units, the answer check) is shared by every lab; the core knows the mathematics of Taschner's script and nothing of the page; the kit (../kit) draws and knows no law; each lab joins the two for one idea; the app groups the labs under the script's parts and lays out the page.

layers.name: vendor
layers.why: Temml, the one library: LaTeX to MathML for the kit's math helper (../ARCHITECTURE.md)

layers.name: kit-core
layers.why: Complex numbers, units and the answer check every lab shares, pure

layers.name: core
layers.why: The mathematics of Mathematik 1 and 2, pure

layers.name: kit
layers.why: Controls, readouts, charts, field maps and card drawings every lab draws with, shared by every lab

layers.name: labs
layers.why: One idea each: a diagram or field to play with, its equations and its practice

layers.name: app
layers.why: Reads labs.json, lays out the sections with their labs, and the theme
